summary.intent: Run load tests against the staging API at 10/20/30 clients to establish baselines, then escalate to 50/75/100 clients to find the single-instance concurrency ceiling, and instrument the uploadFile flow for deeper latency analysis.
summary.outcome: Baselines for 10/20/30 clients were successfully collected (zero errors, near-linear throughput scaling) and documented. Two workflow bugs were fixed via PR #337 (merged). The 50/75/100 client runs were cancelled due to a 30-minute job timeout caused by a scenario filter bug that ran all 5 scenarios instead of just the selected one. A second fix branch was opened at session end to address the timeout and filter issues.

repo: The load-test workflow uses GitHub Actions environment scoping (`environment: staging`) for staging secrets; this causes the UI to show 'Deploying to staging' but performs no actual deployment — purely cosmetic.

The `uploadFile` SDK operation actually makes 5 sequential API calls: 3x POST /ipfs/upload (ciphertext, file metadata, folder metadata) + 2x POST /ipns/publish (file IPNS record + folder IPNS record).

Prometheus metrics available for upload flow analysis: `cipherbox_ipfs_ipns_duration_seconds{operation="pin"}`, `cipherbox_http_request_duration_seconds{route="/ipfs/upload"}`, `cipherbox_http_request_duration_seconds{route="/ipns/publish"}`, `cipherbox_ipns_publish_duration_seconds`.
Baseline format follows `.planning/baselines/NN-<name>.md` convention; phase-18 doc is the reference template.
Mixed-workload 10-client baseline: 434 ops, 4.49 ops/s, 96.6s. 20-client: 856 ops, 8.42 ops/s, 101.7s. 30-client: 1,299 ops, 12.14 ops/s, 107s. All zero errors.
SDK E2E job is named `SDK E2E Tests` in ci.yml; `Verify E2E Passed` is a separate, unrelated required check from release-gate.yml.

code.finding: Missing `environment: staging` caused staging secrets/vars to be empty, silently failing all runs. Also missing `timeout-minutes` increase for high-client runs, and scenario filter was broken causing all 5 scenarios to run instead of the selected one.

`test:single` script used `--testPathPattern` which is a Jest flag — invalid in Vitest. Vitest uses positional args for file filtering. The `--` separator for npm scripts also does not pass args correctly to Vitest's CAC parser; must call `vitest run <scenario>` directly.

workflow: Running multiple `gh run watch` instances simultaneously (polling every 3s each) rapidly exhausts the GitHub API rate limit — avoid concurrent watchers.
When a job uses an environment-scoped secret but does not declare `environment:` on the job, all environment-scoped vars/secrets silently resolve to empty strings with no error.
Vitest does not accept Jest-style `--testPathPattern`; scenario selection requires positional args passed directly to the `vitest` binary, not through npm script `--` forwarding.
GitHub Actions `timeout-minutes` defaults are too tight for load tests running all scenarios at high concurrency — should be set per scenario or the filter must be correct first.
Parallel load test runs against a single staging instance will interfere with each other's results; a concurrency group should serialize them.

friction: First set of 3 load test runs all failed due to two bugs simultaneously: wrong Vitest flag (`--testPathPattern`) and missing `environment: staging` on the job.
Scenario filter bug (`pnpm test:single -- mixed-workload`) caused all 5 scenarios to run instead of just the selected one, massively inflating run time.
Multiple `gh run watch` background tasks simultaneously burned the GitHub API rate limit, blocking status polling for ~5+ minutes.
`gh run watch` exited early on some runs (likely due to the deployment environment approval step), producing stale watchers that reported completion prematurely.
50/75/100 client runs were all cancelled due to the 30-minute job timeout before any results were collected — forced a third fix iteration.
User had to interrupt the assistant mid-sentence when it started investigating `Verify E2E Passed` instead of just adding the required check as asked.
